scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connected desired and observed components are reported without querying a live cluster.

expected.actualClusterState: Six managed components are observed and version drift is explicit.
expected.residualLimitation: Fixture evidence does not prove live Kubernetes discovery.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: A failed resource API is isolated while available observations remain visible.

expected.actualClusterState: Stateful workload observations remain available and deployment observations are unknown.
expected.remediation: Restore deployments API access and refresh inventory.
expected.residualLimitation: Fixture evidence cannot distinguish transport failure from live RBAC denial.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: The primary dependency failure is separated from downstream blocked consumers.

expected.actualClusterState: MySQL is unhealthy while SSC and ScanCentral SAST are dependency-blocked.
expected.remediation: Open MySQL diagnostics and restore database service before retrying consumers.
expected.residualLimitation: Fixture checks do not establish live component performance.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Install planning and verification are repeatable and dependency-aware.

expected.actualClusterState: All planned layers reach verified functional health.
expected.remediation: Retain bounded evidence references for live execution.
expected.residualLimitation: No licensed images or live installation are exercised.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Providers start before consumers and unsafe provider stops are blocked.

expected.actualClusterState: MySQL and SSC become ready before ScanCentral SAST.
expected.remediation: Use the generated typed plan for execution.
expected.residualLimitation: Fixture ordering does not prove chart readiness timing.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Cancellation stops at a safe boundary and records partial progress.

expected.actualClusterState: Completed steps remain visible and later steps are not started.
expected.remediation: Review completion health and submit a fresh retry plan.
expected.residualLimitation: Cancellation cannot reverse a completed mutation.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Only a retryable failed operation can create a fresh bounded attempt.

expected.actualClusterState: The fresh attempt completes and preserves the prior failure history.
expected.remediation: Confirm final layered health before closing the incident.
expected.residualLimitation: Synthetic retry does not measure live recovery time.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Complete profile-bound artifacts restore in reverse dependency order and verify applications.

expected.actualClusterState: All restored scopes pass post-restore application checks.
expected.remediation: Retain checksum and bounded verification references.
expected.residualLimitation: Fixtures do not validate live database contents or protected storage.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Upgrade binds source and target profiles, backup, capacity, health, and dependency order.

expected.actualClusterState: Every upgraded dependency layer passes final health verification.
expected.remediation: Record live downtime and exact-profile evidence separately.
expected.residualLimitation: Fixture evidence does not execute vendor migrations.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Database migration failure requires restore and is never described as Helm rollback.

expected.actualClusterState: Partial migration state is explicit and automatic rollback is blocked.
expected.remediation: Restore the verified source-profile backup with the matching Manager version.
expected.residualLimitation: Recovery duration and data loss bounds require live evidence.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Manager restart preserves terminal history and marks incomplete work interrupted.

expected.actualClusterState: The interrupted operation is visible and no success is inferred.
expected.remediation: Re-observe cluster state and create a fresh recovery or retry plan.
expected.residualLimitation: Fixture evidence does not prove systemd or MicroK8s availability.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Secret values remain write-only across API, browser, history, diagnostics, and operation evidence.

expected.actualClusterState: Only metadata, impact, and health outcomes are observable.
expected.remediation: Use protected inputs or existing Kubernetes Secret references for live work.
expected.residualLimitation: Static scanning cannot prove operator screenshots or external storage handling.
